versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-ai-video-subtitle.
- Transcribes videos or audio files to clean, structured text using a semantic large language model.
- Supports both local files and public video links (Douyin, Xiaohongshu, etc.).
- Removes speech fillers, errors, repetition—outputs refined content.
- Allows custom prompts for summary, rewriting, quote extraction, multi-style text generation, translation, and more.
- Provides detailed usage instructions, error handling, and pricing information.
